title: Industrial AI Quality Inspection Based on IndustryGPT Multimodal Industrial Large Model
summary: SmartMore reports that an IndustryGPT example reached 100% accuracy in 5:27, compared with 50% in 9:31 for manual training. These are technical test results.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: SmartMore reports that an IndustryGPT model-training example reached 100% accuracy in 5:27, compared with 50% in 9:31 for manual training. Commercial production-line applications are also described, but customer financial returns remain unmeasured.
purpose: Simplify industrial inspection-model development and improve defect detection.

ratings.reason: In SmartMore’s model-training example, IndustryGPT achieved 100% accuracy and recall, compared with 50% accuracy and 66.7% recall for manual training, alongside shorter training time. Production revenue remains unmeasured.

ai_role.statement: IndustryGPT converts natural-language requests into model-development steps on the ViMo platform, including annotation, tuning, and training. The quoted result is a technical comparison.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 11: Industrial AI Quality Inspection Based on IndustryGPT Multimodal Industrial Large Model

produced_by: The account does not separately establish the conditions responsible for the benefit.
must_hold: ViMo platform integration and industrial inspection training data

headline: IndustryGPT improves an industrial model-training example
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
